title: The commit hook checks format and compile only; CI takes over what mix precommit drops

story.i_want_to: have a commit checked for format and compile errors in seconds instead of running the whole gate
story.so_that: commits stop costing minutes each, while every check the old gate ran still runs before merge

rationale: A commit touching the root project hands to the fleet's pre-commit (.githooks/pre-commit:105-114), which runs `mix precommit` under the gate lock (claude-config git-hooks/pre-commit:164-181): hex audit, compile, unused deps, format, credo, two citation and env-doc checks, the release set, dialyzer and the whole suite (mix.exs:294-321). The local gate took a median 4m20s on minis (chg shadow report, 36 local gates, 2026-11-20). #985 allows a format-and-compile hook once verify-master, deploy-from-verified, red-master repair and affected branch CI hold, which is this epic's merge order (README). Two precommit steps run in no CI job today, mix loopctl.check_skill_citations and mix loopctl.check_env_docs (grep of ci.yml, 2026-11-20), so this story moves them into Lint before it drops them locally.

acceptance_criteria.description: With LOOPCTL_COMMIT_GATE unset or `fast`, a commit staging a path outside runner/, chg/ and e2e/ runs `mix format --check-formatted` and then `MIX_ENV=test mix compile --warnings-as-errors` at the repo root, and does not run the fleet's pre-commit.
A failing fast check stops the commit with `❌ root: '<command>' failed; the commit is stopped` and exit 1, the same shape as the hook's other areas (.githooks/pre-commit:54-66).
With LOOPCTL_COMMIT_GATE=full, or any value other than fast, the hook execs the fleet's pre-commit exactly as today, so `mix precommit` runs.

The fast gate never calls claude-config's bin/local-gate.sh record, so no commit it passed is attested as `mix precommit` and the pre-push hook's chg_record (.githooks/pre-push:183-196) records no gate verdict for it.
A root project with no deps/ directory prints `⏭  root: no deps/ (never set up); no Elixir gate ran` and lets the commit go on, as the fleet hook does for a scaffold.
The Lint job runs `mix loopctl.check_skill_citations` and `mix loopctl.check_env_docs` as steps, so every step of the precommit alias (mix.exs:294-321) runs in at least one ci.yml job.
runner/, chg/ and e2e/ commits keep their own checks unchanged (.githooks/pre-commit:68-103), in both modes.

test_cases.name: fast mode: a root path runs format then compile, never the fleet hook or local-gate (stub mix, fleet hook, local-gate on PATH)
preconditions: test/loopctl/githooks_fast_commit_test.exs, async: true, @tag :tmp_dir, the throwaway repo and stub logger of githooks_pre_commit_routing_test.exs:6-40; a deps/ dir at the root; a stub local-gate.sh under the fake HOME that logs any call
steps: stage lib/x.ex and run .githooks/pre-commit with LOOPCTL_COMMIT_GATE unset
expected_results: calls == ["mix format --check-formatted", "mix compile --warnings-as-errors"] with MIX_ENV=test on the second
no `fleet` call and no local-gate call in either run

test_cases.name: fast mode: a failing compile stops the commit and names the root
preconditions: as TC-53.5.1, stub mix exiting 1 on compile
expected_results: exit 1 and stderr `❌ root: 'mix compile --warnings-as-errors' failed; the commit is stopped`

test_cases.name: full mode and unknown values hand to the fleet hook
expected_results: both runs: calls == ["fleet "] and no mix call by this hook

test_cases.name: fast mode without deps/ skips and says so
expected_results: exit 0, the exact skip line, no mix call

test_cases.name: guard: every precommit step runs in some ci.yml job
preconditions: mix.exs's precommit alias read with Mix.Project.config()[:aliases][:precommit]; ci.yml parsed with YamlElixir
steps: map each string step to the run line that carries it; map &hex_audit!/1 to `mix hex.audit`
expected_results: every step is found in some job's run lines, and the matched set is non-empty

test_cases.name: the existing routing suite still passes in fast mode
steps: run it with LOOPCTL_COMMIT_GATE=full set in the stub env (its fleet-hook assertions) and unset (its area assertions)
expected_results: its area cases pass unchanged in both; its fleet cases pass under full and are mirrored by TC-53.5.1 under fast

technical_notes: The routing lives in .githooks/pre-commit: the area loop (:33-50), check/3 (:54-66), the per-area checks (:68-103) and the hand-off to the fleet hook (:105-114). The fast gate replaces the hand-off for `outside` paths only when LOOPCTL_COMMIT_GATE resolves to fast.

Format is --check-formatted, never a rewrite, so nothing needs re-staging (the fleet hook re-stages only because mix precommit may rewrite, claude-config git-hooks/pre-commit:194-224). Compile runs in MIX_ENV=test, the env precommit uses (mix.exs:88), so the next mix test reuses _build/test.

Fast gate and the gate lock: neither command touches the test database, so the fast gate takes no gate lock; claude-config bin/gate-run.sh refuses compile and format anyway (claude-config CLAUDE.md, delivery loop step 2).

Why no attestation: local-gate.sh's record names a gate (claude-config bin/local-gate.sh:11-16, :155-208) and the pre-push records any attested commit as that gate's pass (.githooks/pre-push:183-196); a fast attestation would enter chg's shadow log as a full-gate pass and hide misses from US-53.6's criterion. Consequence, stated: after this story live pushes carry no local full-gate verdict, so US-53.6's evidence comes from master commits.

Precommit steps and where CI runs them: hex audit in Security (ci.yml:873-874), compile in Test (:449-450), deps.unlock and format and credo and release_set in Lint (:268-280), dialyzer in Dialyzer (:962-970), the suite in Test; check_skill_citations and check_env_docs in none until this story.

Readers of the old behaviour: CLAUDE.md `Run Commands` (mix precommit, the full gate) stays true; the repo's CLAUDE.md gains one line that the commit hook checks format and compile and the gate is branch CI plus Verify master, with LOOPCTL_COMMIT_GATE=full as the per-commit way back. docs/runbooks/chg-flow.md gains a `Commit hook` section.
LOOPCTL_COMMIT_GATE is read by a git hook only, not by config/runtime.exs or lib/**, so mix loopctl.check_env_docs does not require a deploy/FLY_SECRETS.md row for it.
non_goals: Changing claude-config's fleet pre-commit: loopctl stops calling it for root paths in fast mode; the fleet hook is untouched.
Removing the precommit alias: it stays the full local gate a person runs by hand.

failure_modes.partition: n/a: the fast gate runs two local mix commands with no network; AC-53.5.1 names them.
failure_modes.state: AC-53.5.4: the hook writes no attestation, so the only state it leaves is the compiled _build/test in the committer's own tree.
failure_modes.retry: AC-53.5.1: re-running a commit re-runs two idempotent checks; nothing is recorded twice.
failure_modes.slow: n/a: no external call; a slow compile is the committer's own machine, which AC-53.5.3's full mode would make slower, not faster.
failure_modes.reach: AC-53.5.7: the hook runs in the committing worktree, as every other area check does.

definition_of_done: A commit of a one-line lib/ change on minis prints the two fast checks and finishes in under 60 seconds on a warm tree; the PR body records the time beside the 4m20s median.
`LOOPCTL_COMMIT_GATE=full git commit` on the same change runs mix precommit, shown in its output.
The Lint job of the PR's own CI run shows the two new steps passing.
The PR merges only after the verifier, the verified-only deploy, the red-master hunt and selective branch CI are all live on master (README, Merge order); it may be built before that.
defaults: LOOPCTL_COMMIT_GATE defaults to fast; any value other than fast means full (owner may change).
Fast checks: mix format --check-formatted and MIX_ENV=test mix compile --warnings-as-errors.
Commit time target on a warm tree: under 60 seconds.
